appName.message: Page to PDF — Full Page Screenshot
appName.description: Extension name. Same in every language.

appDesc.message: Capture a logged-in dashboard or private page as PNG or PDF, then give the file to an AI.

actionTitle.message: Capture the full page as PDF

preparing.description: Button label while a file is built.

pdfTooBig.message: The page is too tall for a PDF. Download the PNG instead.
pdfTooBig.description: PDF build failed because the image is too large.

shotMissing.message: Screenshot not found. Click the extension icon again.
shotMissing.description: Result page opened without an id.

shotGone.message: This screenshot is already gone. Capture the page again.

openFailed.description: Result page failed to read the image.

scaledNote.message: The screenshot was scaled down: the browser cannot store an image taller than 32,768 pixels
scaledNote.description: Shown when a tall capture is scaled.

truncatedNote.message: Only the start of the page was captured — it is longer than 30,000 pixels
truncatedNote.description: Shown when a page is cut at the height cap.

staysInBrowser.message: The file stays in your browser until you download it.
staysInBrowser.description: Privacy note on the result page.

pageRefused.message: The page could not be captured

imageTooBig.message: The page is too large and the browser could not build the image. Try again.

noImage.message: Chrome did not return an image

stitchFailed.message: Couldn't assemble the page by scrolling

blockedPage.message: Chrome won't capture this page. Open a normal site — not chrome://, the Web Store, or the built-in PDF viewer.

alreadyBusy.message: This tab is already being captured
alreadyBusy.description: Second capture on the same tab.

captureInterrupted.message: The capture was interrupted. Click the icon again and leave the Chrome bar open until the page is finished.

visibleDenied.message: Chrome did not allow a capture of the visible area. Reload the page and click the icon again.

pageFallback.description: File name when the tab has no title.

noPdfPages.message: There are no pages for the PDF

emptyPdfImage.message: The image for the PDF is empty
emptyPdfImage.description: PDF writer received an empty image.
